title: B2B sales rep turnover in 2026: the data and the fix

visuals.alt: Annual turnover by role: SDRs and BDRs 45%, account executives 30%, sales managers 28%, customer success 25%. Source: Optifai.

visuals.meta: The cost of one bad sales hire
visuals.line: once you add up the four costs that hit before anyone notices the seat is empty

visuals.alt: A bad B2B sales hire costs $177,171 across sourcing, ramp salary, stalled pipeline and manager hours. Source: SalesFuel.

visuals.after_heading: A System That Actually Reduces Turnover
visuals.headline: Four habits. No new software.

items.title: Monday team review
items.text: 15 minutes: who is on pace, who is stuck, what changed

items.title: A real coaching slot
items.text: 20 minutes every other week, on skills, not deal stages

items.title: A visible next step
items.text: Show what the AE or team lead role looks like from here

items.title: Close the exit loop
items.text: Feed exit interview reasons into coaching and hiring

visuals.source: Source: SocialSprint analysis of the Talentfoot 2026 study
visuals.alt: Four retention habits: a Monday team review, a real coaching slot, a visible next step, and closing the exit interview loop.
